title: New part: type Part Number and Part Name freely, no library lookup step
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit".
custom_steps:
1. Open New Inventory Part.
  2. Confirm Part Number and Part Name are free-text fields.
  3. Confirm there is no part library selector and no part library lookup step.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The New Inventory Part dialog has a free-text Part Number field and a free-text Part Name field, and no part library selector or lookup step.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 7 (Create a part without a library item); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.
